events.title: National AI & Robotics Symposium 2026
events.description: Annual gathering of artificial intelligence researchers, student roboticists, and tech innovators featuring competitive coding hackathons and live autonomous drone demonstrations.

events.title: Inter-College Chess Championship
events.description: FIDE-rated blitz and classical chess championship with grandmaster commentary, timed knockout brackets, and university championship trophies.

events.title: Acoustic Unplugged Musical Evening
events.description: An intimate evening of indie music, student band performances, jazz quartets, and original songwriting showcase under the university amphitheater lights.

events.title: University Football League Quarter-Finals
events.description: High-octane collegiate football tournament featuring top university squads competing for a spot in the statewide championship bracket.

events.title: Annual Street Theatre & Drama Showcase
events.description: Socially poignant street plays (Nukkad Natak), contemporary one-act theatre, and monologue competitions presented by the dramatic society.

events.title: Full-Stack Web3 & Cloud Architecture Workshop
events.description: Hands-on developer workshop covering distributed systems, Docker containers, zero-knowledge proofs, and microservice deployment pipelines.

events.title: HackCampus 2026: 36-Hour National Hackathon
events.description: The flagship annual 36-hour hackathon bringing together 100+ collegiate teams to solve real-world problems in HealthTech, EdTech, FinTech, and Green energy.

events.title: Verve 2026: Inter-Collegiate Cultural Festival
events.description: The mega annual cultural festival of dance battles, fashion runway, Battle of the Bands, stand-up comedy, and culinary carnival.

events.title: Annual Inter-Department Athletics Meet
events.description: Track and field competition spanning 100m sprint, 4x100m relay, long jump, shot put, and high jump with medals and department trophy.

events.title: International Conference on Climate Science & AI
events.description: Peer-reviewed academic conference on computational sustainability, climate data modeling, renewable smart grids, and global policy.

events.title: CyberSecurity & Ethical Hacking Capture-The-Flag (CTF)
events.description: Competitive Jeopardy and Attack-Defense style cyber-security CTF covering reverse engineering, cryptography, web exploitation, and digital forensics.
